A marketing campaign is started at the desk of the [[trade office]] and advertises your goods in the [[town]]. You need to make {{item|flyer|10}}s, to earn yourself {{item|fame|1}}. With that fame, you are able to build another [[crate pallet]].

You can also get 1 fame when you complete the quest where you give Ms. Charm a piece of Jewelry (Merchants questline)

Before being able to enter the trade office, you've got to advance the [[merchant|merchant's quest]].
